title: Simple Descriptions of Random Permutations
summary: The paper leaves open whether a random permutation can be expected to have a simple description.

formal_statement.body: The unresolved question is whether a random permutation can be expected to have a simple description.

scope.domain: Mathematical foundations and structural questions about whether random permutations admit simple descriptions in symmetric cryptography.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether a random permutation can be expected to have a simple description.

citations.label: Anomalies and Vector Space Search: Tools for S-Box Analysis

progress.summary: The source explicitly lists this as a third natural question in the paper's contributions section. It connects answering it with disproof of a claim and estimating whether a random permutation can be hoped to be efficiently implemented.
